Author: dexcss
Name: Glamour Sorter
Description: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser — outfit sets as outfit glamours (including seasonal sets, with the Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog automated) and loose items one by one — skipping anything already stored. Includes an extractor that withdraws dresser items back to your bags: all loose items, duplicates only, or one item type such as all rings. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
Changelog: v1.3.0.1: Fixes from the first 1.3.0.0 test. The dresser's "Add to pre-existing outfit glamour?" Yes/No prompt (shown when completing a stored outfit) is now answered automatically — before this it left the store flow stuck with the prompt on screen and froze the run. The Abort button stays clickable while a run is in progress. New watchdogs stop a set whose store window never opens or never produces its confirmation instead of stalling the rest of the run. Extractor: a refused RestorePrismBoxItem is retried (the client briefly refuses while a previous restore settles), waits for the dresser data request to finish, and skips further copies of a unique item (the game cannot give you a second copy while you hold one) instead of stopping the whole run; log lines now name the refused item. v1.3.0.0: Loose items — glamour-able items that belong to no outfit set are now stored as well, one at a time, and skipped when that item is already anywhere in the dresser. Extractor — withdraw dresser items back into your bags: all loose items, duplicates only (keeps one of each), or one item or item type such as all rings, with a live progress line. Item names and icons — planned pieces, duplicates and results now show the item icon, name and category instead of a raw item id. v1.2.0.1: Audit fixes. Completing an existing outfit works again — the pieces a stored outfit is still missing are planned as needed and are no longer listed as sellable duplicates. Deposit verification also accepts the planned pieces leaving your bags, so completing an outfit (or storing with a nearly full dresser) reports correctly instead of "No deposit detected". Store steps can no longer drop a set silently when a window does not open or the dresser closes mid-run, the store loop retries briefly while the dresser data reloads instead of stopping the rest of the run, and the Armoire toggle is locked while storing. /xllog now logs the scanned dresser/held counts for troubleshooting. v1.2.0.0: Full audit. Gear-set protection — pieces registered to a saved gear set are now left in your bags (the same check the game uses for its gear-set icon mark), instead of being pulled out of your gear sets. Smarter duplicates — stored outfit glamours are expanded into their pieces, so a second copy of an already-stored piece is flagged as sellable instead of being re-stored. The dresser's expanded item list is scanned, and a never-fill guard skips window slots the game already marks as part of the stored outfit. New model-duplicate hints show when a planned piece shares its appearance with something already stored. Deposit verification now retries briefly instead of failing on a single read. UI: version in the title, live progress tally while storing, MANUAL tag priority, gear-set and model-duplicate sections. Removed diagnostic logging. v1.1.1.0: The Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog is now automated (synthetic checkbox click + default-confirm callback); all sets route to the dresser. v1.1.0.0: Armoire routing added.
